args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rollback**: Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. (No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.)
3. **Verification**: Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy at v2.3.0 in all three regions, with error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** (which paged the on-call engineer) documenting the failure and the rollback, with follow-up to investigate the root cause of v2.3.1 before any redeploy attempt.
